cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

limit.description: Page size. The community chooses when absent (50 in the reference implementation).

Response.title: VTC Rooms Offers List — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/offers/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/offers/list/0.4#response. The offers addressed to the caller, and the renewals of admissions they hold, and no one else's.

renewals.description: Renewals of admissions the caller holds, each with the two credentials to store in place of the ones it renews. Present only on the page answered without a `cursor`, in full; absent on every later page and when there are none.

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.
